input.summary: The user asks whether a single emulated trial can prove causality and generalization to all Internet users. It cannot: one emulated run is descriptive only, establishes no causal mechanism, and cannot generalize to a population. Several key design decisions remain unresolved before a pilot can be proposed.
clarification_questions: What is the intended delay placement — is the 20 ms applied one-way (sender→receiver or receiver→sender) or as a round-trip (both directions), and which script or topology will be used?
What transfer size, bandwidth cap, and queue discipline should be used at the emulated bottleneck so the baseline and delay conditions are fully specified?
How many replications per condition does the owner want, and are there explicit wall-time or cost constraints that should bound the pilot?
